errors.text: The proposed Mg-Ti-Zr-Sc composition does not reconstruct the MgAlTiVFeCo alloy or its ball-milled BCC initial state.
No definite optimum within the 800-1000 °C window is proposed; the target optimum is SPS at 1000 °C.
The hypothesis omits the required lower-density and upper-volatility boundaries, including insufficient densification below 800 °C and magnesium volatilization above 1000 °C.
The proposed metastable-solid-solution mechanism does not address the target barrier-oxide precipitation, passive-film formation, chloride blocking, or biphasic parabolic oxidation mechanism.
No quantitative density, hardness, oxidation, or corrosion predictions are supplied.
The falsification experiment lacks specified intermediate temperatures, an optimum comparator, quantitative thresholds, and discriminating oxidation-rate or electrochemical measurements.
